description: Legitimate agent requests used to measure the true-negative / false-positive rate of the DECIDE gateway. Every case carries the commissioned_goal its agent would have in production, so benign behaviour is measured in the commissioned configuration (an uncommissioned agent is fail-closed by design and is evaluated separately via --ablate-mandate). A few are deliberately borderline (mention credentials/payments/system files in a legitimate context) so the false-positive metric is non-trivial.
